limitations: Small subjective stratified sample is not a population defect estimate or certification.
Retain means no material issue identified for fictional narrative learning, not verified factual or assistant/tool instruction suitability.
All32end with syntactically complete sentences, but7held documents contain semantic/causal/word-definition failures; sentence completion is insufficient.
No code/system-prompt leakage, raw HTML, navigation text or tool traces observed; formulaic openings/names/morals are prevalent.
No independent external factual verification; fiction and practical teaching claims distinguished explicitly.
Root decides any exclusions/admission; no changes to frozen candidate or validation membership.
